rows.reasoning: The only sources are HB2332 (2025), which Willoughby prime-sponsored and voted Y on; as amended and enacted it only requires the health department to compile postpartum-depression education materials and creates a rural maternal-health advisory committee to study and report on obstetric access. This never addresses the ladder's question of what role government should play in paying for or providing healthcare coverage, so every passage is adjacent and none can support a chair.
